license_note: The repository ships no LICENSE file; the pinned model card carries a frontmatter `license: mit` declaration and no grant prose in the card body. The grant rests on that declaration pointing at the standard MIT text, following the family posture of the reviewed GLM-5 release. The Z.ai API is governed separately by platform terms.

license_evidence.scope: Weights, tokenizer, and chat template in the official zai-org repository, as declared in the pinned model card frontmatter

access_boundary: This record represents the zai-org/GLM-4.6 release of September 2025 at Hugging Face commit be72194883d968d7923a07e2f61681ea9a2826d1. The GLM-4.5 generation, the vision lines, the GLM-4.7 and later generations, the Z.ai API and chat products, ModelScope mirrors, and downstream quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated BF16 checkpoint with tokenizer and chat template in the official repository
The model card documents Transformers, vLLM, and SGLang deployment paths
tradeoffs: No LICENSE file ships with the weights; the MIT grant rests on the frontmatter declaration
No versioning or deprecation policy is published for the line
